The value of this map is the overlay: turn on all three layers and you
can see, block by block, where the capacity clusters sit in relation to
public transportation — and which parcels drive each cluster.

- **Capacity clusters (green hexes)** — areas holding significantly more
  plan-enabled capacity, counted with their neighbors, than a random
  arrangement would produce (Getis-Ord Gi\*). The tiers are confidence
  levels, not capacity amounts: darker green means stronger evidence.
- **Opportunity parcels (blue)** — the 3,419 vacant or economically
  underbuilt parcels where the Growth Policy already calls for more
  housing. Click any parcel for its current use, designation, acreage,
  and plan-enabled units.
- **Mountain Line bus routes (gray)** — the transit network; 58% of all
  plan-enabled units sit within a quarter-mile walk of a stop.
